lead: Tuesday belonged to science and its discontents: [Claude discovered a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats](../summaries/246da2e2481d.md) - the strongest AI-for-discovery result yet - while [Jev in 25 lines of Python](../summaries/c1f415621917.md) charmed the builders and [Claude Code's AGENTS.md-telemetry bug got fixed](../summaries/03ed461abfa9.md). [Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech](../summaries/13123bf3c886.md) shipped, and the business wire produced an unusually dense funding day.

sections.title: Claude finds a novel enzyme system
sections.intro: A CRISPR-repeats discovery that put AI-for-science at the top of HN - the day's defining story.

sections.title: Builder culture: Jev in 25 lines
sections.intro: A tiny typed-decision-model demo, the AGENTS.md telemetry bug and its fix, and fatigue with 'Claudisms'.

sections.title: Voice and interface releases
sections.intro: Gemini 3.8 TTS, Rabbit's OS3 cloud agent reaching local apps, Stripe's knowledge platform, and an AI video studio.

sections.title: The funding cascade
sections.intro: Cyera's $400M, Micro1 at $4B, Firecrawl's $75M, Ema's raise - an unusually dense day of AI financing.

sections.title: Geopolitics and governance
sections.intro: Anthropic disrupting a Beijing-aligned operation, China passing the US for elite AI talent, an 'Office of AI Supervision' proposal, a Dutch chip challenge, and Daybreak for Ukraine.

sections.title: How we talk about AI
sections.intro: Staff mental toll, AI as boring technology, an influencer army, avoiding anthropomorphization, and a condemned mural.
